message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the component versions in the DLL inventory during this 24-hour window. One fresh Aspose.Cells dependency report is a plausible product-family match, but the reported Aspose versions differ from those listed and require manual verification.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. The primary product-list sources were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-15 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-16 07:40 UTC (2026-10-15 13:10 IST through 2026-10-16 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

### Possible matches needing review

**Aspose.Cells dependency exposure — CVE-2026-84008 and CVE-2026-70162**

- **Product/component:** Aspose.Cells for .NET / `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs`
- **Severity:** High (CVE-2026-84008, CVSS 7.5) and Moderate (CVE-2026-70162, CVSS 5.9)
- **Description:** On 15 October, Aspose staff confirmed that Aspose.Cells 26.10 references vulnerable `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs` 8.0.0 and opened ticket `CELLSNET-60732`. The two Microsoft advisories describe unauthenticated CPU-exhaustion denial-of-service conditions in affected package versions.
- **Why uncertain:** The DLL inventory lists Aspose.Cells 26.2 and 25.9.0, not 26.10, and separately lists `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs` 4.7.0. The reviewed evidence does not establish that either listed Aspose.Cells version resolves to an affected 8.x or 9.x dependency.
- **Sources:** [Aspose confirmation](https://forum.aspose.com/t/vulnerable-system-security-cryptography-pkcs-dependency-in-aspose-cells-for-net-26-9-0-and-26-10-0/332963), [CVE-2026-84008](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-846f-f764-76mx), [CVE-2026-70162](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2fmv-rv2c-59x7)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within this run's window. [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Review priority

No immediate response is indicated from a confirmed in-scope finding. Verify the resolved `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs` dependency in deployments using the listed Aspose.Cells versions; escalate only if it falls in Microsoft's affected ranges.
